hero.title: The point containing all points
hero.subtitle: A self-hosted polymorphic AI assistant built in Rust
hero.borges: El Aleph es uno de los puntos del espacio que contiene todos los puntos.

philosophy.title: Five Layers of Emergence
philosophy.closing: Aleph IS Layer 5 — The shell for a ghost.
philosophy.l1_desc: The ocean of human experience — text, code, history, wisdom
philosophy.l2_desc: Medical, Legal, Code, Physics — knowledge gains structure
philosophy.l3_desc: Know-what transforms into Know-how — knowledge becomes capability
philosophy.l4_desc: Plug & Play encapsulation — skills become composable building blocks
philosophy.l5_desc: The soul finally has a shell — transform into any form to act upon the world

architecture.title: 1-2-3-4 Architecture
architecture.core_desc: Rust Core: reasoning, state management, routing
architecture.limbs_desc: Native capabilities + MCP tools + Skills & Plugins

features.title: Features
features.polymorphic_desc: One AI core, infinite manifestations across CLI, desktop, mobile, and messaging
features.learning_desc: POE architecture crystallizes successful experiences into reusable skills
features.memory_desc: Facts DB + vector search + full-text search with automatic compression
features.tools_desc: File ops, web search, code execution, plus MCP protocol for any tool server
features.provider_desc: Claude, GPT, Gemini, DeepSeek, Moonshot, Ollama — use any LLM
features.privacy_desc: Self-hosted, runs entirely on your devices, your data never leaves

footer.borges_closing: The Aleph is one of the points in space that contains all other points.
